prompt.prompt_text:
You are a remediation agent executing the next Hypergenium roadmap step for this repo.

Context (source of truth)
- Roadmap: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md (Rubric v0.1.0)
- Rubric: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
- Maintainability roadmap: hgm-infra/planning/lift-maintainability-roadmap.md
- Evidence plan: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
- Deterministic verifier entrypoint: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Current rubric report: hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json

Current state and why this is the next step
- The latest rubric report is overall BLOCKED with 0 FAIL items.
- One of the remaining BLOCKED items is MAI-3 because its verifier is still a TODO (not configured).
- Implementing MAI-3 can be done entirely inside hgm-infra/ (verifier + documentation + evidence refresh), with no changes to production code.

Step goal (what “done” means)
- MAI-3 must no longer be BLOCKED due to an unconfigured verifier.
- After this step, running bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh must produce:
  - MAI-3 = PASS if no prohibited duplication is detected, OR
  - MAI-3 = FAIL with a deterministic, actionable report (file paths + why they are considered duplicates).
- Evidence must be refreshed under hgm-infra/evidence/, including MAI-3-output.log and an updated hgm-rubric-report.json.

Strict guardrails (anti-drift)
- Do NOT weaken any existing rubric requirement or verifier behavior for other items.
- Do NOT delete MAI-3, mark it N/A, or bump rubric version in this step.
- Do NOT modify application/library code (pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/**, scripts/**) in this step.
- Do NOT change toolchain pins, go.mod/go.sum, .golangci.yml, or .github/workflows/* in this step.
- Writes MUST be confined to hgm-infra/** only.

Allowed write locations
- hgm-infra/verifiers/** (add MAI-3 verifier implementation + wire it into the main verifier)
- hgm-infra/planning/** (update maintainability roadmap + rubric/evidence plan references for MAI-3)
- hgm-infra/evidence/** (refreshed outputs + roadmap progress note)

Procedure
1) Confirm baseline (required)
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm MAI-3 is currently BLOCKED in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json.
   - Inspect hgm-infra/evidence/MAI-3-output.log and confirm it states the verifier is not configured (TODO).

2) Define a concrete, reviewable MAI-3 policy (doc-only, inside hgm-infra/)
   Update: hgm-infra/planning/lift-maintainability-roadmap.md
   - Add a short section: “MAI-3 duplication policy (v0.1.0 implementation)” describing exactly what the verifier will check.
   - Keep the policy strict enough to be meaningful, but not so broad it flags normal repeated patterns.
   - Suggested initial policy (acceptable starting point):
     - Scope: only Go files under pkg/** and cmd/**
     - Ignore: *_test.go files
     - Detect either (or both):
       (A) exact duplicated file bodies after stripping comments/whitespace, OR
       (B) duplicated non-trivial function bodies (e.g., normalized AST/printed body) above a minimum size threshold
     - Output: deterministic list of duplicate groups with file paths and a stable hash identifier
     - Exit codes: 0 for pass, 1 for duplicates found, 2 reserved for “BLOCKED” only if required tooling is missing (avoid if possible)

3) Implement the MAI-3 verifier (deterministic, no external dependencies)
   Preferred approach: implement a small Go program under hgm-infra/ and invoke it from the main verifier.

   3a) Create a new verifier program
   - Create: hgm-infra/verifiers/mai3-dupcheck.go
   - Requirements:
     - Deterministic output ordering (sort paths, sort groups).
     - No network access; no third-party deps (standard library only).
     - Scan only in-scope directories: pkg/** and cmd/**.
     - Exclude *_test.go.
     - Emit a human-readable report to stdout describing:
       - what policy is being applied
       - for each duplicate group: a stable fingerprint/hash and the list of files involved
     - If duplicates are found: exit(1). If none: exit(0).

   Implementation suggestions (choose the simplest reliable option):
   - File-level duplication:
     - Read each file, strip comments (token scanner) and whitespace, hash the remaining bytes (sha256).
     - Group by hash; any group with >1 file is a duplicate violation.
   - Optional function-level duplication (only if you can do it safely and deterministically):
     - Parse Go AST with go/parser, collect FuncDecl bodies, render with go/printer to a canonical string, hash, and apply a minimum size threshold to avoid noise.

   3b) Wire the verifier into the main entrypoint
   - Update: hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Replace the MAI-3 TODO with a real check, for example:
     - run_check "MAI-3" "Maintainability" "go run ./hgm-infra/verifiers/mai3-dupcheck.go"
   - Keep all other rubric items unchanged.

4) Update planning docs to remove MAI-3 “TODO verifier” references
   - Update hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
     - MAI-3 “How to verify” should point to bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh (MAI-3) and/or the underlying go run invocation.
   - Update hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
     - MAI-3 “How to refresh” should no longer be TODO once implemented; point to the verifier entrypoint and confirm evidence path remains hgm-infra/evidence/MAI-3-output.log.

5) Refresh evidence (required)
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json:
     - MAI-3 is no longer BLOCKED for “TODO verifier”.
   - If MAI-3 is FAIL, ensure MAI-3-output.log contains actionable duplicate groups. Do NOT fix duplicates in this step; just record findings and propose the next remediation workstream.

6) Record progress (required)
   - Create: hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M3-MAI-3.md
   - Include:
     - Date/time
     - Summary of the MAI-3 policy you implemented
     - What files were added/changed in hgm-infra/
     - The final MAI-3 status (PASS/FAIL) and evidence pointers:
       - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
       - hgm-infra/evidence/MAI-3-output.log
     - If FAIL: list the top duplicate groups and propose a narrowly-scoped follow-up step ID (e.g., M3-MAI-3-REM-1) that would dedupe them.

Acceptance criteria
- MAI-3 is evaluated by a real deterministic verifier (not a TODO) when running bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh.
- Evidence is refreshed under hgm-infra/evidence/ (including MAI-3-output.log and hgm-rubric-report.json).
- No files outside hgm-infra/ were modified.

If you get blocked
- If you cannot implement the checker without third-party deps, STOP and document the constraint + a minimal alternative (still deterministic) in roadmap-progress-M3-MAI-3.md.
- Do not leave MAI-3 as a TODO; prefer a simpler but correct check over a complex one that cannot run.
prompt.step_description: Implement a deterministic MAI-3 (canonical semantics / duplication control) verifier so MAI-3 is no longer TODO/BLOCKED, then refresh rubric evidence and document any findings.
